expectation: Cytoplasmic/fibrous stain in smooth muscle, myofibroblasts and pericytes: bright rings around vessels, the muscularis mucosae and muscularis propria, and thin stromal fibres. Epithelium should be negative.
observed: A: yellow lines the muscularis mucosae, forms rings around vessels in the mesentery and runs as striated bands in the thick outer muscle; the epithelium is blue only. B, C: epithelium and lumen are negative, so the stain is not diffuse haze. D: bright fibrous layers along a vessel wall, clearly cell-shaped.
why: Signal is confined to smooth muscle and vessel walls and absent from epithelium, matching aSMA's expected pattern.
